findings.explanation: CrCl <50 mL/min: NCCP Table 2 specifies 80% of the original eribulin dose. Confirm the original dose, prior reductions and any hepatic/toxicity modifications with oncology pharmacy; do not re-escalate an already lower dose.

cases.name: Dialysis may consider not automatic dose
cases.source: NCCPp3Table2

findings.explanation: Haemodialysis: 80% of the original dose may be considered after Consultant/pharmacy review; this is not an automatic dose or a validated dialysis timing instruction.

cases.name: ChildPughA
cases.source: NCCPp3original-dosepercent; EMAabsolute hepaticdoses differ slightly; specialistreconciliation

findings.explanation: Child-Pugh A: NCCP Table 2 specifies 80% of the original eribulin dose. Confirm hepatic context, original dose and previous reductions with oncology pharmacy. Do not compound reductions or re-escalate. The SmPC uses absolute hepatic doses, so pharmacy must reconcile product/protocol conventions.

cases.name: qt_risk_factors independently actionable
cases.source: NCCPp2/EMA§4.4cardiac/electrolyte/neutropeniarisk

findings.explanation: Arrange risk-directed ECG review at baseline and during treatment as clinically indicated; check QT-prolonging drugs and potassium, calcium and magnesium. These sources do not specify a universal cycle-day ECG or numeric QTc dose rule.

cases.name: uncorrected_low_electrolytes independently actionable
cases.source: NCCPp2/EMA§4.4cardiac/electrolyte/neutropeniarisk

findings.explanation: Correct low potassium, calcium or magnesium before initiating eribulin. During ongoing therapy, review the abnormality and ECG/QT risk before deciding on dosing; monitor these electrolytes periodically. This source does not define an automatic numeric dose reduction.

cases.name: acute_febrile_neutropenia independently actionable
cases.source: NCCPp2/EMA§4.4cardiac/electrolyte/neutropeniarisk

findings.explanation: Withhold eribulin and arrange urgent acute assessment/treatment for current febrile neutropenia or suspected neutropenic sepsis. Confirm recovery before any subsequent reduced dose.

cases.name: active_infection independently actionable
cases.source: NCCPp2/EMA§4.4cardiac/electrolyte/neutropeniarisk

findings.explanation: Assess and treat the current infection and check ANC urgently as appropriate. ANC <1 with fever/infection enters the source toxicity pathway; infection alone does not determine a numeric eribulin dose.
